verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.avalara.com that describes the developer site. The docs are served as markdown (.md) pages covering API methods, SDKs, the MCP server and AI use cases, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all standard paths returned 404).
